نبذة

Glam & Go Salon JVC is your go-to beauty salon in JVC, Dubai, where looking good meets feeling good. We offer polished, confidence-boosting results in a warm neighborhood salon atmosphere. Our most-loved services include hair colour, balayage, blow dries, hair extensions, BIAB & hard gel nails, manicures, pedicures, semi-permanent makeup, lash treatments, facials, waxing, and threading. Clients love our natural results, skilled team, premium products, and home service across Dubai. Xx

التعليقات

178

A visit to Glam & Go Beauty Salon JVC Dubai is marked by a friendly and accommodating atmosphere, where the team provides exceptional service. Clients particularly enjoy the BIAB gel manicures, noting the precise and clean work that lasts for weeks, while others rave about the threading services for eyebrows, highlighting the skill of the technicians. With a focus on personalized care, the salon ensures every treatment is tailored to the client's needs, making each appointment a delightful experience.
